title: Add RecipeTagChips view
description: Create RecipeTagChips.swift. Reads the 'tags' metadata key from Recipe.metadata, splits on commas (trimming whitespace), and renders a horizontally-scrolling row of pill-shaped chips. Each chip is text-only with .foregroundStyle(.tint) and a .regularMaterial background. The entire row is hidden (not rendered as empty space) when the tags key is absent or its value is empty after splitting.
acceptance_criteria: A chip is rendered for each comma-separated tag value.
The row is entirely hidden when tags metadata is absent or empty.
Chips scroll horizontally when they overflow available width.

handoff_summary.completed: Created CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeTagChips.swift. The view reads metadata.tags (Metadata already parses comma-separated tags with whitespace trimming), conditionally renders a ScrollView(.horizontal) with HStack of Text chips styled with .foregroundStyle(.tint) and .background(.regularMaterial, in: Capsule()). When tags is empty the body produces nothing (no empty space). Three #Preview cases cover: tags present, empty string value, and absent key. Also fixed a pre-existing @Previewable ordering error in RecipeStatStrip.swift that broke the build; xcodebuild BUILD SUCCEEDED after fix.
handoff_summary.remaining: None — all acceptance criteria met. Visual verification of chip rendering and horizontal scroll overflow is a manual step (per UI guidelines §Visual verification).
handoff_summary.risks: None significant. The @Previewable fix in RecipeStatStrip.swift is a one-line reorder with no behavioural change.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester bead should verify tag parsing edge cases (whitespace-only entries are filtered, empty string produces hidden row) and build a UI test for horizontal scroll with many tags.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — RecipeTagChips.swift is a new file. RecipeStatStrip.swift edit is a one-line reorder in the preview block only; no logic conflict risk for sibling beads.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Used metadata.tags (the existing computed property on Metadata) rather than manually subscripting metadata["tags"] and splitting — avoids duplicating logic already unit-testable at the model layer. Chip padding uses explicit multiples of 4/8 (12 h, 6 v) per UI guidelines. Font is .caption with .medium weight to keep chips compact but legible.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests written (tester agent responsibility). The three #Preview cases cover absent key, empty string, and populated tags. Model-layer tag parsing is already covered by CookbookCore's Metadata tests.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Visual rendering (chip layout at various Dynamic Type sizes, horizontal scroll overflow, light/dark mode chip appearance) cannot be verified without a running simulator — flagged as a manual verification task per ui-guidelines.md §Visual verification.

conflict_risks: None — RecipeTagChips.swift is a new file. RecipeStatStrip.swift edit is a one-line reorder in the preview block only; no logic conflict risk for sibling beads.
